rationale: dual_domain_bilateral_n2i-claude-agentic: warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=1, pretrain_steps=20, n_iter=30, grad_clip=1.0, lr=0.005, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=1, proj_kernel=5, proj_sx=1.0, proj_sy=2.0, proj_sr=0.02, img_kernel=7, img_sx=1.5, img_sy=1.5, img_sr=0.02, batch_size=1, train_n=200, val_n=214, outer_wall_s=1050, per_scene_s=None, seed=42, rationale=ITER-1 feasibility (search-20260619-01, corrected protocol). SOLVER: dual_domain_bilateral_n2i = PER-IMAGE Noise2Inverse with a trainable bilateral-filter stack (6 params: proj_n_bf=img_n_bf=1, 3 sigma each), self-supervised, warm-start pre-pass + per-scan fit. STAYS PER-IMAGE (warm-start amortized pre-pass on the 4 train patients to capture a generic BF-sigma init, then an INDEPENDENT per-scan Adam fit on EACH val slice OWN half-angle measurements, GT-free; NEVER revert to amortized train-then-forward). HARD-WIRED path (baked into solver/loader/evaluate_calibrated, NOT cfg keys): staged_canonical data, v3 mayo_ldct_fitted geometry (sod 595.362 / sdd 1086.803 / det_spacing 1.285044 / ps 0.700857), per-sample-ps half-angle projector swap (pipe.R_half per slice), bg_target=truth, val=ALL 214 L277 slices, metric=321px detector-geometry FOV (evaluate_calibrated default for AGENT4CT_DATASET=mayo_ldct_2d; no fov= override). SIX-BOX: (1) iter-1 baseline -- does per-image bilateral N2I run on Mayo at all under the corrected 214-slice/321px-FOV metric and record a finite val_score+comparison.png within the 20-min budget. (2) FAILURE MODE: 214 INDEPENDENT per-scan fits (each backprops the 2304-view FBP adjoint) blow the 20-min wall -- the breast/demo bilateral N2I runs fit only 16-24 scenes in ~4-23 min; 214 is ~9-13x worse, and the U-Net DD-C run timed out at 24 scenes/25 min. (3) MINIMAL-COST per-image bilateral config: per-scan n_iter=30 (cheap), warm-start short (pretrain_steps=20 cap, 1 ep), mid bilateral depth proj_n_bf=img_n_bf=1 at Wagner abdomen sigma defaults (kernel 5/7), grad_clip=1.0 MANDATORY (the 2304-view FBP adjoint overflows otherwise), in-solver outer_wall_s=1050 so it RECORDS even if not all 214 finish. (4) HYPOTHESIS: per-image bilateral N2I is FBP-bounded + budget-starved at 214 slices -> expect hr near 0 (at/below LD-FBP), because half-view N2I info loss < full-view FBP and the warm-start fixes the structural ceiling; the 6-param bilateral physically CANNOT overfit a scan so it may edge out the U-Net N2I on a clean read. (5) BUDGET MATH (HARD 20-min = 1200s train+score): anchored on Mayo bilateral N2I smoke 764666 (n_iter=40, val_n=2, per-image loop elapsed 10.3s => ~5.15 s/scene => ~0.129 s/(iter*scene) on the 2304-view adjoint; ~2x cheaper than the U-Net N2I 9.8 s/scene). At n_iter=30: 214*30*0.129 ~= 828s (13.8 min) + ~100s fixed startup (build 4 per-ps projectors + 214-slice LD-FBP baseline + score-214 + figure) ~= 16 min, fits inside 20-min with margin. n_iter=40 would be ~18.4 min + fixed ~= 20 min (too tight, risks the wall); n_iter=20 ~= 11 min (safe but gives the BF sigmas fewer steps to settle from warm-start). Chose n_iter=30 as the sane mid-cost; bilateral cannot overfit so more steps do not hurt. outer_wall_s=1050 (17.5 min) in-solver backstop guarantees a recorded result even if some slices run long; val stays ALL 214 (do NOT reduce val_n). (6) Do NOT return control mid-campaign.
